ios.desc:
SonicBit is your personal cloud storage and media hub. Save files directly to the cloud without using your device storage.

KEY FEATURES

• Cloud Storage & Seedbox
Save files of any size directly to your cloud storage. Our servers handle everything 24/7.

• Torrent to Cloud
Add torrent magnet links or .torrent files and let SonicBit fetch them directly to your cloud. No need to keep your device running — our seedbox handles it all remotely.

• Stream Player
Play videos directly from your cloud or local device — supports MKV, MP4, AVI, and 20+ formats. No need to wait for files to finish transferring.

• Open With Support
Open video files from your device's Files app directly in SonicBit's Stream Player.

• Massive File Support
Handle files up to 100GB+ without filling up your phone. Perfect for large files like videos, archives, and more.

• Smart Storage Analytics
Visual breakdown of all your files by type — videos, audio, documents, archives, and more. Always know exactly where your storage goes.

• Cross-Platform Access
Your cloud syncs across devices. Start on your phone, access it from your computer.

• File Management
Browse, organize, and manage all your cloud files. Create folders, move files, and keep everything organized.

• Real-Time Progress
Track your transfers with live progress updates, speed indicators, and status controls.

FREE TO START
Create your account in seconds and get 4GB of cloud storage completely free. Upgrade anytime for more space and features.

PREMIUM PLANS
Unlock more storage, faster speeds, unlimited video playback, and priority transfers with our flexible premium plans.

Need help? Contact us at support@sonicbit.net
